units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 8:4">Ter. VIII, 4</cite> <he>כדי שיצא הר׳ וכ׳</he> as long as it would take a poisonous reptile to come forth … and drink; <cite ref="Chullin 10a">Ḥull. 10ᵃ</cite>.—V. <cite ref="T00491"><he>רָחוֹשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 45:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLV, 2</cite> <he>אם ר׳ למה אמירה ואם אמירה למה ר׳</he> if thought is meant, why does the text mention speech, and if speech, why thought?; a. e.—V. <cite ref="T00544"><he>רַחֲשׁוּשׁ</he></cite>.
